verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a section on installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills (插件和技能 安装、创建和发布), which suggests users can author and share custom capabilities. That is a single thin index mention, and skills are not clearly the same thing as full custom assistants. missing for 10: explicit custom-assistant/persona builder with its own instructions, attaching custom knowledge files, documented sharing flow for assistants, hands-on or independent corroboration.
